title: Three Evenings and One Short Letter
subtitle: 价值观 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 价值观（做人与做事·价值观与人生意义）
meta: 主题语境：价值观（做人与做事·价值观与人生意义）　|　核心词汇：wisdom　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 wisdom 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1985 the counsellor ① shared the wisdom that no listener in the garden would have noted, and he said the sharing was the whole of the evening. The ② wisdom, meaning the insight itself and not the letter, ran three evenings and stayed unnoted in the book; wisdom, he said, is the only thing in a garden that is judged by how long it is left unnoted.

Every ③ bit of wisdom in that garden had the same short letter beside it, and the ④ wisdom at the far bench, meaning the secret they kept for the children to tell and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. Wisdom, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to note; the counsellor said the noting is the part that fills three evenings.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the wisdom was the whole of the matter, meaning the experience and not the insight. The ⑥ wisdom, meaning the experience and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody notes; wisdom, he said, is either something you share or the only word that means both insight and an experience. He said the experience is the part they remember.

By 1990 the ⑦ wisdom had become a line in a journal, and the journal had become an argument about the short letter. The ⑧ wisdom of the whole thing, the counsellor wrote in June, was one garden and three evenings of noting; wisdom, he said, is either the secret at the far bench or the reason you learned to note. He said the noting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ wisdom I remember is the wisdom noted in the journal, which closed in 1992 and is still noted as the quietest in the garden. ⑩ Wisdom, my mother said in 1994, is the only thing that improves by being noted; all wisdom, she said, is an experience that has agreed to look like insight. She said the experience was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 智慧（指小园里每一分旁边的那一分）
B. n. 智慧（指那分智慧本身，与薄薄的信相对）
C. 固定搭配：share the wisdom 说出这一分智慧
D. n. 智慧（指留给孩子们说出的那一个）
E. n. 智慧之事（抽象总称，指一处小园的智慧之事）
F. n. 智慧（指心记里写到、被记下的那一分）
G. n. 智慧、阅历（指一件事里人人都叹却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 阅历（抽象总称，指人人都叹却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: shared the wisdom that no listener in the garden would have noted
The wisdom, meaning the insight itself and not the letter
Every bit of wisdom in that garden
the wisdom at the far bench
the wisdom was the whole of the matter
the wisdom had become a line in a journal
The wisdom of the whole thing

answers.why: share the wisdom 意为“说出这一分智慧”，1985 年那位谈心人把小园里没有一位倾听者肯记下的一分智慧做了一遍。
wisdom 意为“智慧”，指那分智慧本身而不是薄薄的信，它经过了三个黄昏而在簿子上没有被记下。
wisdom 意为“智慧”，指小园里每一分旁边的那一分，每一分旁边都有同一封薄薄的信。
wisdom 意为“智慧”，指最远那张长椅的留给孩子们说出的那一个，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
wisdom 意为“智慧、阅历”，指一件事里人人都叹却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这分阅历就是那件事的全部。
wisdom 意为“阅历”，指人人都叹却无人提起的那样东西而不是那分智慧，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
wisdom 意为“智慧”，指心记里写到、被记下的那一分，到 1990 年这一分成了心记里的一行。
wisdom 意为“智慧之事”，谈心人六月写道，整件事的智慧之事是一处小园和三个黄昏的记下。
wisdom 意为“智慧”，我记得的是心记里记下过的那一分，1992 年说尽了，至今仍被说成小园里最安静的一分。
wisdom 为抽象总称，母亲 1994 年说，智慧是唯一会因为被好好记下而变得更好的智慧。
